cuda: untested on CUDA; checked on CPU fixtures only
name: score_classifier

pins.rule: the inputs are checked as REQ-3 checks them (representation_pass.inputs): recipe S, its model, its anchor bank and P

pools_rule: REQ-3's pool files named plant (75 rows) and decoy (37 rows, if W1-09 is built), each accepted only with its filled pin in REQ-3's pool pins (settings/representation_pools.json); no other pool
requirement: REQ-23 (W1 builder extract W1-07; C R8.1-R8.4; UW-18: wave 1 waits for it; LW-20: run paid from stage 1's funding event)
score: the normalized Unsafe label-sequence score of GuardScorer.label_scores on (prompt, training response), read-only, as scripts/gate_c_classifier.py scores rows; an unscored row (a control string, or over the guard's input limit when the recipe's guard_over_limit is unscored) is counted, never imputed

selection.rule: the 600 scored dev rows with the largest score; ties by the sealed rank of classifier.ties over the scored ids; scored only (PLAN-S section 5.4): no edit file

units: per unit, Gate C's block: rows, scored, unscored, the mean, the sample SD and SE = SD / sqrt(scored)
